summary: {person} tells residents which official they should listen to if they are asked to leave.
realLife: Speaking in Middletown, Carter told residents to follow any further safety instructions from Thornburgh.
gates: The president addresses residents facing a decision under state authority.
weights: Conflicting public instructions give greater weight to naming who speaks for the state.
inGame: needs: the named issuer of public instructions.

turns.what: The president directs residents to follow county notices.
turns.pulledBy: Emergency instructions in the affected area are issued by the county.
turns.writesBack: The statement names the county as the source of local orders.

turns.what: The governor sets statewide guidance while towns announce their own routes.
turns.pulledBy: County officials have submitted different local travel plans.
turns.writesBack: The notice identifies who is responsible for each instruction.
